build_ObjectNavILNet: build an ObjectNavILNet neural network for object navigation with RGB visual encoding and RNN state encoder
create_ObjectNavILPolicy: create an ObjectNavILPolicy instance from config for imitation learning object navigation tasks
transform_images_ObjectNavILNet: transform RGB observation images from channels-last to channels-first format with visual encoder
forward_ObjectNavILNet: run forward pass through ObjectNavILNet with observations, RNN hidden states, prev actions, and masks
freeze_backbone_ObjectNavILNet: freeze the visual encoder backbone parameters and optionally convert batchnorm for fine-tuning
